BranchEvaluatesAll.description: An anyOf member's own unevaluatedProperties evaluates every key where that member matches.

ContainsInMember.description: contains in a member evaluates the items it matches where that member matches: all strings, or a number at most.

WithoutApplicator.description: Without an applicator unevaluatedProperties is additionalProperties: a required key outside properties has its type.
